shared.body: (a) Visitors, including suppliers and contractors, enter the Annex only through the main lobby on Halvern Street, sign in at the security desk on showing photo identification and wear the visitor badge issued to them. (b) When a visitor signs in, the desk phones the host; if the host does not answer, the desk phones the host's unit line. (c) The host, or a member of staff the host names, meets the visitor in the lobby, escorts the visitor while in the building and brings the visitor back to the lobby to sign out. (d) Staff must not let any person pass through a badge door on their swipe.
